conditions_locator: Original preprint pp.4–5 sections 2.1–2.3: COT pretreatment, polymerization cycles, TG and LOI methods; Table 1 on p.6 initial physical properties.
pairing_evidence: Section 2.2 defines COT, PMT-n, PHT-n and alternating PMT/PHT-n. Section 3.1 explicitly reports the TG residual weights and measured LOIs for COT, PMT-6, PHT-6 and PMT/PHT-3. Figures 4 and 5 share those labels. Later durability LOIs are not paired with initial TG.
source_location: Original 21-page preprint PDF; complete main text, methods, results, conclusions, references and figure captions reviewed; Figure 4/5 pixels inspected. Listed supplementary file is GraphicalAbstract.tif, not numerical SI.
limitations: Author preprint v1 posted 16 September 2024; final journal DOI 10.1007/s10570-025-06393-2 is not substituted and requires source-wide version/reuse review. Four initial prepared fabrics are linked by the same labels in the preparation, TG prose/Figure 4 and measured-LOI prose/Figure 5. Residual weight values are explicit in the TG prose, but an assessment temperature is not attached to the four numbers; the 800 °C scan endpoint is stored separately and no R800 is inferred. The approximate 369 °C degradation description is not an exact onset or rate maximum. Figure 4 was visually checked for consistency, without estimating coordinates. Tables 1–4 sometimes spell PMT as PMD, and prose sometimes reverses MPD letters to DMP; the sole MPD-TMC chemistry and three alternating cycles identify the same PMT/PHT-3, not an extra preparation. Table 3 repeats its initial physical properties and does not create another state. The source gives an ISO 5660-1:2002 reference for micro-combustion calorimetry; this source method inconsistency is retained outside TG/LOI, and its gas flows, mass, temperatures and heat-release peaks are not transferred. LOI averages are from three tests; plotted error bars have no explicit numerical uncertainty or defined statistic. Durability washing in disturbed water is a separate exposure; its LOIs, including 26.6% after 24 h, have no corresponding TG. Other alternating cycles have LOI and MCC data but no matched exact TG. Fabric shrinkage means planar-density changes must not be used to reconstruct dry add-on. No additional atmospheric condition, preprint version or repeated figure label is counted as a new state.
